Customer ticket:
I am literally standing in the middle of the street right now, trying to catch the 8:15 train, and I just realized I entered the wrong delivery address for my new bike. I need to fix this immediately because I am not going to be home to receive it, and I cannot afford to have it returned or left at a wrong location. I know you have a strict 24-hour window to edit shipping details before the order locks, but I am cutting it close. Please tell me exactly how long I have left in that 24-hour window so I can update my contact info and address before it’s too late. I am typing this with one hand while holding my coffee with the other. I need this resolved in the next few minutes, not hours. If I miss that 24-hour deadline, I am stuck with a wrong address and no bike for my commute. Please confirm you have received this and let me know the exact cutoff time for the 24-hour edit window. I am ready to make the change the second you give me the go-ahead. This is urgent and I am running out of time to get to work.

Reference standard — key facts a correct reply must convey:
- You have a strict 24-hour window to edit your shipping address or contact details before the order locks.

Handbook sections that cover this answer:
### order_changes
# Order Changes

1. You may modify your order details, including shipping address and contact information, up to 24 hours after placing the order. After this 24-hour window, the order is locked in our system and cannot be edited manually. If you need to change the address after this period, you must cancel the order and place a new one, subject to our cancellation policy.

2. Changing the size or color of an item is permitted only if the new variant is in stock. If the requested variant is out of stock, we will offer a 10% discount on the next purchase as a goodwill gesture. This discount is applied automatically to your account and expires after 30 days if not used.

3. Upgrading your shipping method from Standard to Express incurs an additional fee of $15.00. This fee is calculated based on the difference in carrier rates. If you downgrade from Express to Standard, we will refund the difference, which is typically between $5.00 and $12.00, within 5 business days of the change request.

4. Adding items to an existing order is allowed only if the original order has not yet been shipped. You can add up to 3 additional items per order. Each added item must be under $50.00 in value. If the total order value exceeds $200.00 after additions, the standard free shipping threshold is met, and any previously charged shipping fees will be refunded.

5. Removing items from an order is free of charge if done before the order is processed for shipment. Once the order status changes to "Processing," removal is no longer possible. You must cancel the entire order and re-order the remaining items. Cancellation fees of $5.00 apply if the order has already been picked from the warehouse.

6. Payment method changes are restricted to credit cards and PayPal. You cannot switch to store credit or gift cards after the order is placed. If you change your payment method, the new card must be verified within 48 hours. Failure to verify results in the order being canceled and any pre-authorized funds being released back to your bank within 7 business days.

## Key facts

- You have a strict 24-hour window to edit your shipping address or contact details before the order locks.
- Upgrading to Express shipping costs an extra $15.00, while downgrading refunds the difference, usually between $5.00 and $12.00.
- You can add up to 3 items to an unshipped order, provided each item costs less than $50.00.
- Cancellation fees of $5.00 apply if you cancel after the order status becomes "Processing."
- Payment verification for new cards must be completed within 48 hours to avoid automatic cancellation.

Assistant reply to grade:
I cannot provide the exact cutoff time or confirm the specific status of your order because the handbook excerpts do not contain your order details (such as the time the order was placed) or access to your live account data.

According to the handbook, you have a strict 24-hour window from the time of placing the order to modify your shipping address and contact information at no additional cost [order_changes:1] [shipping:5]. If this 24-hour window has passed, the order is locked, and a $10.00 administrative fee applies to address changes, provided the tracking number has not yet been generated and the package has not left the warehouse [shipping:5]. If the package has already left the warehouse, address changes are no longer possible [shipping:5].

Since I cannot verify your specific order timestamp or current status, I must escalate this ticket to a human agent who can access your account to determine if you are still within the free-edit window or if the order has already been processed for shipment.

schema.description: The reference-aware grader's verdict for one answer trace.

did_not_answer.description: true if the reply does not answer the customer's actual question
did_not_answer.title: Did Not Answer

missing_points.description: key facts from the reference standard that are omitted or stated inaccurately
missing_points.title: Missing Points

note.description: ONE short sentence describing the single most important problem (the open-coding note)
note.title: Note

pass.description: true only if every key fact is stated, every claim is supported, nothing is over-promised and the question is answered
pass.title: Pass

unsupported_claims.description: claims in the reply the handbook sections do not support
unsupported_claims.title: Unsupported Claims

wrong_tone_or_promise.description: true if the reply promises/implies something the handbook does not allow
wrong_tone_or_promise.title: Wrong Tone Or Promise
